title: Introduction to Git with Scott Chacon of GitHub
summary: Scott Chacon introduces Git by showing what happens under the hood for basic commands: staging, committing, data storage, branching, merging and pushing. He contrasts it with Subversion and shows history viewing with log.
why: HN commenters keep recommending it as the best video for newcomers who want to understand how Git works technically.

quote.text: This is the video that I keep recommending to new people who want to know how it works on a technical level.
